utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Thursday, 25 June. Can you all hear me? Teams reckons we've got everyone.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah. Before we start, there's a birthday cake in the office. Quite a substantial one, actually.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: That's a very stores way of saying you've already measured your slice.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Never mind cake, the heating in the portakabin is still making it feel like November indoors. In June. Just having a moan, nothing for the list.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Lovely. Factory sauna, without the nice towels.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes a facilities podcast—what's already closed?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I tested the stacker yesterday and it's all fine now. That's finished from my side.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, so that isn't another test outstanding?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: No, closed. Just giving you the result.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Same here, I tested the stacker yesterday and it's all fine now. We were on it together, not two separate outstanding jobs.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: One stacker, two people saying it's fine. I'll take that.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And I finished the repair on the turbine one last night. That's done as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, Grace. Finished, not carried over.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: While I've got the mic, I saw the pressure on the Engel dip for a few minutes. It came back on its own. Just an observation, no ongoing issue from that.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, similarly, I noticed the line 2 was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down. Nothing outstanding there either.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Both settled without anything being changed, then? Just so I don't confuse those with open jobs.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Exactly. Mine's just a handover comment.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: The one that is still blocked: we're still waiting on parts for the Line 3 Screw and Barrel. Nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, still waiting. No change to that position, I'm afraid.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Blocked, no new action coming out of that this morning.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And we were going to replace the belt on the old turbine, but that's been pushed to next month, so ignore it. Not happening today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that's off today's list. Separate from the repair that's already finished.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Onto the actual open bits. We've got taking vibration readings on the water booster. Who's able to take that?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I'll take vibration readings on the water booster.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Grace. That's yours, then.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, happy with that. Readings on the water booster, got it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And the guarding on the outfeed conveyor—checking that was the other one, wasn't it? Sorry, nearly spoke over you.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, you're right. I'll check the guarding on the outfeed conveyor by the 28th.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Okay, I've got Sarah Okafor against that one, by the 28th. Not against me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, that's me. No accidental volunteering for you.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Grace, can you do the pre-use checks on the FLTs next Tuesday? It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Um, no, sorry, I can't take that one. I haven't got the capacity next Tuesday, and I don't want to say yes then leave it hanging.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fair enough. Ash, can you take the pre-use checks on the FLTs instead? Still next Tuesday, and it's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll do the pre-use checks on the FLTs next Tuesday. Understood that it's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped out a bit there. That was next Tuesday?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Next Tuesday, yes. The urgency stands; that's the agreed timing.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yep, accepted. That's with me, not Grace.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Grace, can you investigate the pressure drop on the big valve by the gate by the end of the week? It's not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yes, I'll investigate the pressure drop on the big valve by the gate by the end of the week.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Just separating those in my head—that isn't the Engel dip you mentioned earlier?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: No, separate thing. This is the big valve by the gate. The Engel came back on its own; that was just an observation.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. No extra investigation on the Engel coming out of this.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Got you. The big valve by the gate, end of the week. Not an emergency, but I won't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie Brennan, can you run the monthly fire alarm test Monday? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I can't cover Monday, sorry. Better give that to someone else rather than leave my name on it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Grace, can you run the monthly fire alarm test instead, Monday? Normal priority still.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yes, Monday works for me. I'll run the monthly fire alarm test, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Monday for that, not next Tuesday with the FLTs? Sorry, the audio jumped again.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. Fire alarm test Monday with Grace, normal priority. Different item.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Teams is doing a lovely job of making five things sound like fifteen.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: At least nobody's accidentally assigned me the cake. That's already a shared resource.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Any other bits of that lost in the audio, before we wrap up?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I think it's my end making the noise. The mic's rubbing on my collar. Not a mysterious new bearing fault.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Ah, that explains it. Sounded like someone was dragging a pallet through the call.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: All clear for me now. And the stacker stays closed, just to avoid that getting mixed into the recap.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes. So, Grace has the water booster readings, and I've got the guarding check on the outfeed conveyor by the 28th.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Agreed. I've also got investigating the pressure drop on the big valve by the gate by the end of the week—not an emergency but don't let it slip—and the monthly fire alarm test Monday, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Ash has the pre-use checks on the FLTs next Tuesday. It's urgent. Nothing left against Grace for that one.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: That's right, I'll do those. Clear on the timing and urgency.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And no movement on the Line 3 Screw and Barrel until the parts arrive. Still blocked, not something we've picked up today.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep. Belt replacement on the old turbine stays pushed to next month as well. Not sneaking that back in.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. That's the list agreed, then. Thanks, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Cheers. May the cake survive until the rest of us get there.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: No guarantees. Bye.
